risks.text: yt-dlp extraction breaks when sites change; needs bundled updater and fast yt-dlp upgrades.
MonoTorrent stable releases are infrequent (3.0.2); pinned and integration-tested.
Expiring/cookie-bound URLs cannot be resumed after restart because cookies are kept in memory only by design.

Some mirrors (e.g. OVH proof servers) cap connections per IP and temporarily block clients that exceed it. FluxGet now backs off, lowers its connection count and remembers the cap per host, but the default connection count still needs benchmarking.
IPv6 routes that black-hole connections stalled .NET's sequential connect; fixed with a Happy Eyeballs connector, needs testing on IPv6-only networks.
Installer is 200 MB, dominated by Deno (94 MB) and FFmpeg DLLs (148 MB). yt-dlp needs a JS runtime for YouTube; a smaller runtime would need re-verification.
MonoTorrent 3.0.2 has no sparse-file option: deselected files sharing a piece are created at full length until the torrent finishes.
Signing pipeline works, but only a self-signed test certificate exists. A CA-issued OV/EV certificate or Azure Trusted Signing account is needed before public release to avoid SmartScreen warnings.
